seo.title: Menu
seo.description: The River Oaks lunch, dinner and drinks menus at Izakaya WA in Houston — small plates, sushi and sashimi, robata skewers, rice and noodles, and a considered sake list.

hero.title: The menu
hero.intro: An izakaya menu is meant to be shared. Order a few plates, pass them around, and add more as the evening goes on.

image.alt: Close-up of freshly made nigiri sushi

notice.label: Please note:
notice.text: prices are taken from our printed River Oaks menu and may change with the seasons or with the day's fish. Lunch is served Tuesday to Saturday, 11:30 am to 2:00 pm. Call us for today's selection.

locationNote: The menu shown is for our River Oaks location.
